purpose: Make each LLD packet deterministic enough that an implementation AI translates accepted design into code without inventing product semantics, persistence authority, transport shapes, state transitions, audit vocabulary, job recovery behavior, or source-module architecture.

readiness_states.drafting: Packet is under construction; normative leaves may be incomplete.
readiness_states.review_ready: Semantic packet construction is complete enough for design review, but implementation may still be blocked by V2 closure gaps.
readiness_states.ai_implementation_ready: Packet has passed the V2 structural/integrity gate and both technical review passes; implementation AI has no material design discretion inside the packet scope.
readiness_states.owner_accepted: Project owner accepted the complete packet after technical review. Application implementation remains globally blocked until all Beta 1.0 packets are owner_accepted.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet exposes named value objects, DTOs, cursor bodies, cross-packet result types, or nontrivial structured command/query inputs/outputs
conditional_paths.rule: Every named structured value crossing a module or transport boundary resolves to one versioned machine-readable type contract.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet owns semantic settings persisted through LLD-02 SettingDefinitionRegistry
conditional_paths.rule: Every setting pins exact key, owner, contract/version, default provider, validator, semantic equality, unknown-field policy, storage class, bounds and value contract.
Every mutation resolves exact action_type/action_version/payload_schema/payload_version and allowed target/result/ref/sensitivity contract.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet enqueues, handles, resumes or cancels durable background work
conditional_paths.rule: Every job type registers exact job_type, contract_version, payload_schema, checkpoint_schema, retry_policy, crash_recovery_policy, cancellation_policy, sensitive_field_policy and coalescing/dedup behavior.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet owns a persisted or derived state machine with more than two governed states or correction/reversal semantics
packet owns tables, indexes or triggers
conditional_paths.rule: Packet declares its migration allocation and every schema object is owned by exactly one forward migration.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet is being evaluated for ai_implementation_ready
conditional_paths.rule: Every command/query/repository/service/route/job maps to exact source-module destination and allowed dependency direction.

conditional_paths.required_when: packet generates or verifies a file/export artifact
conditional_paths.rule: Artifact format/version, filenames, structure, ordering, field types, verification and atomic publication are exact.

leaf_granularity.goal: One authoritative operation or tightly coupled implementation concern per leaf file.
leaf_granularity.command_rule: One public or internal authoritative command per leaf file unless a documented inseparable transaction family requires otherwise.
leaf_granularity.query_rule: One public/workbench/review query per leaf file unless a documented shared projection contract makes separation harmful.
leaf_granularity.schema_rule: Split by one table or tight invariant aggregate; avoid omnibus domain schema files that require unrelated implementation context.
leaf_granularity.algorithm_rule: One named algorithm/state fold/parser/guard per leaf file.
leaf_granularity.exception_rule: Any leaf over 12000 UTF-8 bytes requires a packet-index granularity_exception with reason and split analysis before ai_implementation_ready.

rules: No prose placeholder such as review context, base revisions, actor/source, schedule input, evidence or equivalent may remain unbound; it must resolve to an exact versioned type.
State-dependent eligibility and freshness checks rerun in the authoritative UnitOfWork even when previewed outside it.
NO_CHANGE semantics are explicit and share COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 idempotency rules.
Cross-domain participants reuse the caller UnitOfWork and one command receipt unless an accepted contract explicitly defines a different orchestration.
Collection ordering is total and deterministic.
Keyset cursor fields and null ordering are explicit.
Safety-critical preview data includes exact revision/fingerprint bindings used by the corresponding command.
Path/query/header/body ownership of every input field is explicit.
Unknown request fields follow the referenced DTO contract.
Transport adapters never calculate authoritative domain projections from client data.
All mutating routes carry command_id through the canonical command envelope and LLD-12 anti-forgery/authenticated-session context.

IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE is a single global Foundation replay-only compatibility error additionally admissible on any mutating route when, before handler preparation, a matching already-committed legacy receipt lacks a provably exact stored result. Route leaves need not duplicate this migration-compatibility code; it never arises on a never-before-committed command and never authorizes re-execution.

request_hash_includes: exact preview/review/input fingerprints that authorize the requested mutation
command_envelope.replay_equality: A committed replay is eligible only when command_id, command_type and request_hash all match. Mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. An eligible replay returns only its exact immutable committed-result snapshot; a legacy receipt without a provably exact result returns IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE and the owning command is never prepared or rerun.
command_envelope.canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical UTF-8 serialization with the command-specific DTO normalization contract.

rules: Cursor is opaque to clients and integrity-protected by the server transport/security policy.
Cursor re-use with changed material filters or sort registry fails as invalid/stale rather than silently changing result semantics.
Query leaf pins exact last_key_tuple types and comparison predicate.
Every table/index/trigger owned by LLD packets 01..12 appears in exactly one forward migration allocation.
A packet may own more than one forward migration when an accepted later repair adds owned schema; prior accepted/applied migrations remain immutable.
Migration sequence is globally unique and ordered by dependency.
Accepted migrations are immutable and follow LLD-01 manifest/hash rules.
No implementation agent chooses a migration number ad hoc.

review_passes.pass_1: Semantic authority, requirement coverage, identity, lifecycle, source precedence, cross-domain ownership and history preservation.
review_passes.pass_2: Implementation determinism, transactionality, security, concurrency, performance, failure safety, transport/schema/job/audit exactness and AI coding granularity.

ai_implementation_ready_gate: all mandatory and applicable conditional contracts are complete
spec-integrity gate PASS with zero blocker/high findings
no unresolved TODO/TBD/future exact FK or unbound authority reference exists inside packet scope
all referenced HLD ownership remains accepted
global_implementation_rule: Even an ai_implementation_ready packet may not start SOMA application implementation until the complete Beta 1.0 LLD set is owner_accepted, unless the project owner explicitly changes that gate.
